data.body: Gerrit 1869 PS1 failed only on macOS/Python 3.13 in tests/unit/test_repo_isolation_guard.py::test_session_finish_fails_explicitly_when_porcelain_times_out: the intended inner five-second Git watchdog fired, but the test harness outer 12-second deadline expired during pytest cleanup. This is a separate proven timeout-oracle defect tracked by tapestried-abhorrent-tuna and Gerrit 1876. Added an explicit depends_on link; after 1876 lands and closes, rebase 1869 onto that merged fix and repush immediately. No recheck/retry of the failed run.
